qualification.en: The lines support universal school choice, 529 Education Savings Accounts and homeschooling. They do not say that public school money would follow a student to a private or religious school. It is shown and not scored.

quote: Republicans believe families should be empowered to choose the best Education for their children. We support Universal School Choice in every State in America. We will expand 529 Education Savings Accounts and support Homeschooling Families equally.

sourceTitle.en: 2024 Republican Party Platform, “Make America Great Again!” (PDF, undated; adopted by the RNC Platform Committee July 8, 2024, per the GOP press release of that date), p. 17

summary.en: The platform says Republicans support universal school choice in every state, will expand 529 Education Savings Accounts, and will support homeschooling families equally.
